title: Terrain / curved satellite surface and ringworld
goal: Drive across the satellite terrain and verify that the close collision/detail tiles stay attached to the curved ringworld and its distant DEM scenery. The full 8192-pixel source covers about 90 km, or 11 m per pixel.
changes: The playable terrain, collision, satellite mapping, camera and Warthog gravity now share the ring coordinate frame used by the DEM backdrop. This removes the elevated far-terrain band visible after long drives. Saved Warthog tuning and cache contents are retained; curved terrain gets a separate cache identity. Fine grass/rock surface detail is a later refinement.
controls: WASD drive; Space brake; C chase/driver camera; hold RMB to look; Home centres look. E switches between driving and inspection flight. R places the Warthog upright on loaded ground at its current location. F5 opens the existing vehicle setup; F2 opens this brief. In flight: WASD, Space/Ctrl vertical, Shift faster. Enter starts when ready. F8 starts/stops jitter capture, including the preceding five seconds of suspension, contact, camera and frame history. Logs are saved automatically.
